description:
Habit Tracker keeps one daily ritual in view.

WHY IT WORKS
• One tap to check in, one streak to keep
• Works offline; your data stays on the device
• A 30-day history you can read at a glance

Optional monthly subscription adds unlimited habits and cross-device sync. Restore purchases any time from Settings. No ads, no data resale.
